correctness.rationale: The frozen mathematics is correct. Cyclic query edges admit a cyclic orientation. A loop or simple directed cycle in the contraction can be lifted using disjoint paths in the component trees; conversely any directed cycle under a query orientation must project to a quotient cycle. A height-h chain forces at least h components, and longest-chain-ending rank layers supply equality. At equality the chain traverses every component and fixes its entire topological order, proving uniqueness of the strict surjection. Conversely each such surjection and its fiberwise trees gives a maximum support. The exact sum follows by Cayley, including singleton fibers and a chain's empty support. The repaired RESULT retains this proof and domain. Fresh enumeration via transitively closed suborders of a chain and relabeling independently matched literal extension traces to the forest-with-ordered-fibers criterion and the maximum-support count in every order 1–5 (4,231 posets and 4,332,544 support candidates at order 5).
